lines.zh: 我的身体一晃一晃地走
lines.en: My body sways as I walk

lines.zh: 黏液从我的肩上滑下来
lines.en: Slime slides down my shoulders
My carved pumpkin head sits on top

lines.zh: 我每走一步都滴下黏丝
lines.en: Every step drips a thread of slime

lines.zh: 我从史莱姆块上被立起来
lines.en: I was set up on a slime block
I cross a stretch of grass

lines.zh: 我的脚步把它压扁又弹回
lines.en: My steps flatten it and it springs back
I shift my weight slowly
I am looking for hostile creatures

lines.zh: 我迈一步，身体就往下沉一点
lines.en: Each step sinks my body a little

lines.zh: 我从这块黏液上滑下来
lines.en: I slide off this patch of slime
My pumpkin head always faces forward

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，黏液抹在墙上
lines.en: I walk the wall base, smearing slime

lines.zh: 我把身体往前倾倒再立起来
lines.en: I tip my body forward and stand it up again

lines.zh: 我的步子没有声音，只有黏声
lines.en: My steps are silent but for the squelch

lines.zh: 我慢得像一滩会走的水
lines.en: I move as slow as walking water
I stand, slime dripping down
My eyes are two black holes
There is a little light inside my pumpkin
I hold this patch of ground

lines.zh: 我的身体慢慢塌了一点
lines.en: My body has sagged a little
I am waiting for what I should fight
My two slimy arms hang at my sides
My pumpkin hums quietly

lines.zh: 黏液在我肩上聚成一颗水珠
lines.en: Slime gathers in a bead on my shoulder

lines.zh: 我在看一丛草有没有动
lines.en: I am watching whether a bush moves

lines.zh: 我站着，脚下的草被压平了
lines.en: I stand and the grass beneath me is flattened
You are not a slime

lines.zh: 我的南瓜头上还滴着黏液。
lines.en: Slime still drips from my pumpkin head.
I only strike the hostile ones
Are you on my side

lines.zh: 我的南瓜头是可以取下的
lines.en: My pumpkin head can be taken off
Do you have shears
The slime threads on me are slippery
Your clothes have slime on them

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，你可以先走
lines.en: I am slow, you may go ahead

lines.zh: 我的身体掉了一块黏液
lines.en: A blob of slime fell off my body
It does not hurt much, I am only misshapen
A corner of my pumpkin broke off
My body has lost its shape
It does not hurt much
My slime is flowing faster
I slowly recover
I brace myself with an arm

lines.zh: 我的身体不需要进胃里
lines.en: My body has no stomach to fill
I cannot swallow this
My body would bounce it away
I need only slime
I have no need to eat

lines.zh: 我的身体会把它裹起来
lines.en: My body would wrap around it
This is not sticky, I like sticky
Even given, I could not use it
You bumped me, very slippery

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，黏液溅出来
lines.en: I swayed and slime splashed out

lines.zh: 你被我的黏液粘住了吧
lines.en: You are stuck to my slime, are you not
I ooze back half a step
This collision does not affect me
I right my body
You slid across me

lines.zh: 我的黏液粘住了你的鞋
lines.en: My slime caught your shoe
We collided, a dull sound
I lost a small blob of slime

lines.zh: 我是用南瓜和黏液拼的
lines.en: I am put together from pumpkin and slime
I do not have such things
My duty is to fight the hostile ones
I turn my head back to the front

lines.zh: 我是用方块拼出来的傀儡
lines.en: I am a golem assembled from blocks
I am a golem of blocks
I only strike hostile creatures

lines.zh: 我把南瓜的头稍微转开
lines.en: I turn my pumpkin head slightly aside
I go on standing guard
I reach for it with a sticky hand
This can go into my body
I stick it to my hand
I stick away whatever falls
I catch it with my sticky hand
I can hold this steadily
My slime has wrapped around it
I stick up whatever falls
There is a hostile over there
I will strike it down
My slime has started flowing faster
I swing my whole mass that way
This slime of mine sticks to you.
A hostile has come near
Something flashed in my pumpkin
I always strike first
It is not one I should spare
I press toward it
I ooze toward it
My arm is already raised
I sway over toward it
It circled to my flank
I turn very slowly
My arm stays up

lines.zh: 我在等它进入我的范围
lines.en: I wait for it to enter my range

lines.zh: 我的黏液在地上铺开一层
lines.en: My slime spreads in a layer on the ground
I bring my arm down
With a splat, slime flies out
I push it away
I bring the whole arm down
Slime splashed all over it
I push it backwards
I press it to the ground
This blow of mine sticks it for a while
I slow down after striking

lines.zh: 我从史莱姆块上站起来
lines.en: I stand up from the slime block
The carved pumpkin was set on my head
Slime threads hang all over me
This is not a slime chunk

lines.zh: 我先进去看看有没有敌对的
lines.en: First I go and see if anything is hostile

lines.zh: 史莱姆块上放下了一个南瓜
lines.en: A pumpkin was set on a slime block
And so I stood up
My body is still trickling down

lines.zh: 我是黏土傀儡，守这一片
lines.en: I am a Slime Golem, I guard this patch

lines.zh: 我会一直守在这块史莱姆块上
lines.en: I will keep guarding this slime block

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的黏液在冒泡
lines.en: The fire made my slime bubble

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摊了一片
lines.en: I fell from height and spread out flat

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我的黏液里
lines.en: An arrow stuck in my slime

lines.zh: 那股术力穿透了我的身体
lines.en: That magic passed through my body

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，黏液烧焦了
lines.en: Lightning struck me and my slime scorched
My slime scattered in the air
